name: Yasha Kagura Densetsu
source:
A Momot*ro Densetsu visual novel/ADV about Yakshahime's
journey into a dream world separate from her friends.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE156213.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部以《桃太郎传说》为题材的视觉小说ADV，讲述夜叉姬与伙伴们分离，独自踏入梦中世界的旅程。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE156213.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
